name: GDELT-tone shock fade on 4h bars (broad-news overreaction reversal, long)
rationale: MECHANISM: variant of the headline-shock fade that uses gdelt_tone (broad global news mood) instead of crypto-native news_sentiment. Broad-tone shocks (macro fear spilling into crypto) are the purest emotional overshoots because the information is often NOT crypto-specific — the tape overreacts and reverts once traders realize the headline does not change crypto fundamentals. Entry: gdelt_tone in an extreme LOW tail AND a confirming 4h price drop (ret_Nd). Fade long, exit fast. Tests whether the reversion premium attaches to the broad macro-tone series distinctly from crypto news. DISCONFIRMER: must clear REAL 4h round-trip fees (edge < 2x cost => mirage, kill). If gdelt_tone-fade and news_sentiment-fade fire on the same bars with the same returns, they are one signal — keep only the more-covered one. If the fade works on random bars, it is generic mean-reversion — kill.
catalyst: extreme-negative broad news tone confirmed by a 4h price drop
